messages.content: Binary search both iterative reurc. Code + complexity

Straight answer — what you should write in exams:

---

### ⏱️ **Binary Search — Time Complexity**

| Case | Explanation | Complexity |
|------|-------------|------------|
| **Best Case** | Key is exactly at the middle position in the first comparison | **O(1)** |
| **Worst Case** | Key found at last step after continuously halving array | **O(log n)** |
| **Average Case** | Expected number of halves to locate element | **O(log n)** |

---

### 📌 Why O(log n)?
Each step reduces the search space by **half**:

n → n/2 → n/4 → n/8 → ... → 1  
Number of reductions = **log₂(n)**

So the time complexity = **O(log n)**

---

### 📦 Space Complexity
| Method | Space | Reason |
|--------|-------|--------|
| Iterative | **O(1)** | Only few variables |
| Recursive | **O(log n)** | Due to recursive stack frames |

---

This plus your full code is more than enough to score full marks.
